input.quote: (a) General Servicing Obligations. The Servicer will manage, service, administer and collect on the Receivables with reasonable care using that degree of skill and attention that the Servicer exercises for all comparable device payment plan agreement receivables that it services for itself or others according to the Servicing Procedures.
input.rationale: Cellco (Servicer/Marketing Agent) gives express performance warranties in our favour that meet and in fact exceed the preferred position. Section 3.2(a) (p0082) imposes a workmanlike-equivalent performance standard (reasonable care and the degree of skill and attention used for its own comparable receivables, per the Servicing Procedures); Section 6.1(a) (p0257, p0268, p0269) contains express reps of compliance with all applicable Laws and material compliance with the Servicing Procedures, made as of the Closing Date and remade as of each Acquisition Date and expressly surviving transfer and pledge — i.e. no 12-month/90-day cut-off at all. There is a real remedy: breach of the Eligibility Representation triggers mandatory reacquisition/acquisition of the affected Receivable at the Acquisition Amount (p0072, p0073), the securitisation analogue of repair/replace/refund, backed by the asset representations review and dispute resolution machinery, and the security-interest reps survive termination and may not be waived (p0062). Crucially, there is no "AS IS" clause and no disclaimer of express or implied warranties anywhere in the document, so nothing swallows the express warranty. Two sub-elements are noted but not flagged: there is no conformance-to-documentation or malicious-code warranty (not applicable — this agreement procures servicing, not software or deliverables), and Section 6.2(a) limits the Servicer's and Marketing Agent's liability to willful misconduct, bad faith or gross negligence, which is a limitation-of-liability point handled under that rule rather than a warranty failure (the reacquisition remedy operates independently of that fault standard).
